aboutPage.metaDescription: Agathe Karinthi-Martin leads Next Impact, an independent studio specialising in high-performance websites and applications for SMEs and social-economy organisations. 20 years of digital experience, 6 in development.

journey.label: The journey
journey.title: From WordPress user to modern stack architect
journey.subtitle: Twenty years using, customizing and rebuilding WordPress — from the back office to headless architecture.

step1.title: Fifteen years using WordPress before coding for it
step1.description: Set aside a passion for software development to dive into digital communications. For fifteen years, used WordPress daily: building pages, managing content, configuring themes, debugging plugins. Lived from the inside what works — and especially what frustrates editorial teams using this tool.

step2.title: From WordPress customization to bespoke development
step2.description: Up against the limits of off-the-shelf themes and plugins, returned to coding. First case by case to fix specific friction, then structurally: custom themes, bespoke WordPress plugins, API integrations. A full-stack WordPress expertise, built out of necessity.

step3.title: Three WordPress stacks, one conviction

user.label: User expertise:
user.text: 15 years using WordPress as an editor — to understand what absolutely has to be preserved in its admin.

tech.label: Technical mastery:
tech.text: Two complementary skill sets — modernizing the WordPress sites that are worth it (classic or Headless + Next.js) and building custom web and mobile applications when WordPress is no longer the right tool.

ai.label: AI acceleration:
ai.text: Audit tools and AI workflows to deliver WordPress sites at modern tech standards, faster.

step3.figaroMention: An approach featured in <lien>Le Figaro</lien>, on Headless WordPress modernization for SME websites.
